issue.title: Privatize FilesQueryIndexResult after artifacts pane split
issue.description: On HEAD 392dcc962, just check reaches lint (symvision) and reports FilesQueryIndexResult in src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/artifacts/files_query_index.py as an unused public class. Commit c756a7c63 made the formerly-private result public during the files_pane.py split, claiming it was imported across modules, but rg shows every construction/type check remains inside files_query_index.py; only FilesQueryIndexMixin is imported by files_pane.py. This independently blocks the repository check gate alongside separately routed active-epic findings. Rename the dataclass back to a private symbol, remove it from __all__, update its in-file annotations/usages, and run focused artifacts-files tests plus just check. The reporting agent's own diff touches only src/sase/llm_provider/registry*.py.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction at a newer HEAD (master 4fae4e794, one commit past the 392dcc962 cited in the description). Ran 'just check' from workspace sase_14 while my own diff touched only tests/test_plan_filter_query*.py; it failed at lint (symvision) with FilesQueryIndexResult in src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/artifacts/files_query_index.py among 9 unused public symbols. Confirmed pre-existing rather than caused by my diff: 'git stash -u' + 'just _lint-symvision' on the clean 4fae4e794 tree reports the identical 9-symbol list. The other 8 symbols are causally owned by active epic sase-mi (routed there); FilesQueryIndexResult is this bead's and still blocks the check gate for every agent.

Independent reproduction on HEAD c6d84d2a4 while splitting src/sase/ace/tui/modals/models_panel_display.py. The required just check passed formatting, Ruff, mypy, pyscripts, test-waits, changelog, and terminology gates, then Symvision reported FilesQueryIndexResult in src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/artifacts/files_query_index.py among 9 unused public symbols. My diff touches only models_panel_display.py and the new models_panel_display_options.py, so this finding is unrelated and still blocks every repository check; the remaining 8 findings are being routed to their causally related active epic.

Independent reproduction while implementing patch_inline_filter_bar_1 on HEAD 271b8f1a2. My diff touches Patch query/filter TUI code and focused Patch tests, but after removing the current diff's own Symvision private-import/QueryCorpus findings, 'just check' still reaches lint(symvision) and reports FilesQueryIndexResult in src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/artifacts/files_query_index.py as an unused public symbol. This is unrelated to the Patch filter change and matches this ready task; the other symbols seen in this older workspace are already routed through/recorded on sase-mi and its closure notes say they are fixed upstream.
